characters.continuity: Beauty and the Beast (1991 Animated Film)
characters.summary: Belle is an intelligent and resourceful young woman who relies primarily on her quick thinking, resourcefulness, and empathy rather than physical combat. She uses improvised tools and her environment when cornered.

techniques: Improvised weapon strikes with clubs or stones

sources.supports: General character background, intelligence, and plot events in the 1991 animated film.

notableResults.note: Overpowered physically until rescued or aided by circumstances.

unknowns: Exact combat training outside of basic self-reliance.

characters.summary: Blossom is the self-proclaimed leader and tactical brain of the Powerpuff Girls. She combines superhuman flight, strength, and durability with ice breath and advanced tactical planning.

mechanisms: Pink energy force fields and auras

weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychological manipulation and overthinking
limitations: Stamina drain from sustained maximum power output

sources.supports: General powers, leadership role, and abilities of Blossom in the 1998 animated series.

notableResults.note: Defeated using tactical planning and superpower utilization.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly at supersonic speeds.
Ability to project freezing ice breath.

unknowns: Limits of her ice breath duration under extreme heat.

characters.summary: Bluey is an imaginative Blue Heeler puppy who engages in elaborate make-believe games with family and friends. She has no combat experience or superhuman abilities.

mechanisms: Dodging through play and running away

limitations: Puppy physical attributes and zero combat training

sources.supports: Character nature as a domestic animated puppy focused on imaginative play.

characters.continuity: Popeye the Sailor (Classic Fleischer/Famous Studios Cartoons)
characters.summary: Bluto is a massive, aggressive brute who relies on overwhelming raw physical strength, heavy punches, and intimidation to bully opponents, though he is routinely defeated when Popeye consumes spinach.

mechanisms: Thick muscular hide and heavy durability

weaknesses: Susceptible to being easily tricked or outmaneuvered
limitations: Lacks ranged energy attacks or supernatural powers beyond cartoon physics

sources.supports: Bluto's role as Popeye's muscular, bullying rival with brute strength.

notableResults.note: Typically dominates early confrontations until Popeye eats spinach.

campaignTags.claim: Extremely large, bulky human frame towering over normal characters.

unknowns: Variations between Bluto and his analogous counterpart Brutus.

characters.summary: Bob Belcher is a weary, pragmatic burger joint owner whose combat style is nonexistent outside of clumsy flailing, awkward wrestling, or talking through disputes.
weaknesses: Poor stamina and low pain tolerance
limitations: Zero combat training or superhuman attributes

sources.supports: Bob Belcher's profile as a realistic, ordinary restaurateur.

unknowns: Any hidden martial arts ability not shown in normal continuity.

weaknesses: Can be provoked into extreme, reckless rage if pushed too far
limitations: Dependent on emotional state for triggering hardcore combat ferocity

characters.summary: Bugs Bunny is a master of cartoon physics, reality manipulation, and psychological misdirection. He effortlessly evades pursuers and turns the environment against them using disguises, tunneling, and fourth-wall breaks.

techniques: Reality warping via paint or gag props

mechanisms: Spatial relocation via drawing doors on walls

weaknesses: Fails to take certain persistent antagonists seriously immediately
limitations: Power is tied to narrative humor and cartoon logic constraints

sources.supports: Bugs Bunny's characteristics, classic cartoon physics, and iconic tactics.

notableResults.note: Consistently outsmarts and humiliates his pursuer.
Outwits Daffy in various hunting season and rivalry disputes.

campaignTags.claim: Creates functional doors and tunnels anywhere via cartoon manipulation.
Carries an assortment of classic cartoon gags, explosives, and props.

unknowns: Exact boundaries of his reality-warping capabilities outside standard gag setups.

characters.continuity: Looney Tunes (Meme / Space Jam 2 / Modern Media)
characters.summary: Big Chungus is an exaggerated, immensely obese incarnation of Bugs Bunny who trades his usual lithe agility for overwhelming massive physical bulk and deadpan intimidation.

mechanisms: Thick cushion of cartoon fat absorbing physical impacts

weaknesses: Significantly reduced movement speed and agility compared to base Bugs
limitations: Loss of high-speed running and rapid tunneling due to immense mass
characters.formDifferences: Massively increases physical size and weight while heavily reducing speed and standard trickery in favor of pure absurd bulk.

sources.supports: Origin and presentation of the Big Chungus internet meme and licensed media.

notableResults.note: Confounds Elmer Fudd through sheer absurd presence.

unknowns: Whether this form retains full access to classic cartoon paint-portal reality warping.

characters.summary: Buttercup is the toughest and most aggressive member of the Powerpuff Girls. She specializes in brutal hand-to-hand combat, reckless brawling, and overwhelming offensive pressure without hesitation.
weaknesses: Impulsive and hot-tempered; vulnerable to being baited into traps
limitations: Prone to ignoring defensive strategy in favor of pure offense

sources.supports: Buttercup's aggressive personality, physical combat style, and powers in the 1998 series.
